info.title: Inventory API
info.description: The Inventory API is used to create and manage inventory, and then to publish and manage this inventory on an eBay marketplace. There are also methods in this API that will convert eligible, active eBay listings into the Inventory API model.

addressLine2.description: The second line of the street address, such as a suite or apartment number. Returned if defined. Maximum length: 128.

city.description: The city of the inventory location. Required for fulfillment centers; for warehouses, required with stateOrProvince if postalCode is not provided. Returned if defined. Maximum length: 128.

The price set here must be lower than the current 'Buy it Now' price. This field is only returned by getOffer and getOffers if set.

autoDeclinePrice.description:
This is the price at which Best Offers are automatically declined. If a buyer submits a Best Offer that is equal to or below this value, the offer is automatically declined on behalf of the seller. This field is only applicable if the bestOfferEnabled value is set to true.

The price set here must be lower than the current 'Buy it Now' price and the price set in the autoAcceptPrice field (if used). This field is only returned by getOffer and getOffers if set.

If the English system of measurement is being used, the applicable values for dimension units are FEET and INCH. Note: If the listing duration expires for an auction offer, the listing then becomes available as a fixed-price offer and will be GTC.

This container indicates the listing policies that are applied to the offer. Listing policies include business policies, custom listing policies, and fields that override shipping costs, enable eBay Plus eligibility, or enable the Best Offer feature.

It is required that the seller be opted into Business Policies before being able to create live eBay listings through the Inventory API. Sellers can opt-in to Business Policies through My eBay or by using the Account API v1's optInToProgram call. Payment, return, and fulfillment listing policies may be created/managed in My eBay or by using the listing policy calls of the sell Account API v1. The sell Account API v1 can also be used to create and manage custom policies. For more information, see the sell Account API v1.

For unpublished offers where business policies have yet to be specified, this container will be returned as empty.

regulatory.description: This container is used by the seller to provide regulatory information.

The Minimum Advertised Price feature is only available on the US site. tax.description:
This container is applicable and used only if a sales-tax table, a Value-Added Tax (VAT) rate, or a tax exception category code will be applied to the offer. Only Business Sellers can apply VAT to their listings. It is possible that the applyTax field will be included with a value of true, but a buyer's purchase will not involve sales tax.

A sales-tax rate must be set up in the seller's sales-tax table for the buyer's state/tax jurisdiction in order for that buyer to be subject to sales tax. Sales-tax rates for different jurisdictions can be added/modified in the Payment Preferences section of My eBay, or the seller can use the sales tax calls of the Account API v1.

Note: Sales-tax tables are available only for the US and Canada marketplaces.
Refer to Taxes and import charges for more information on setting up and using a sales tax table.

To see which item condition values that a particular eBay category supports, use the getItemConditionPolicies method of the Metadata API. The Item condition ID and name values topic in the Selling Integration Guide has a table that maps condition ID values to ConditionEnum values. The getItemConditionPolicies call reference page has more information.

This container is used if the seller is offering one or more calculated shipping options for the inventory item, or if the seller is offering flat-rate shipping but is including a shipping surcharge based on the item's weight. This container is used to specify the dimensions and weight of a shipping package.

Note: Package weight and dimensions are only supported for the following marketplaces: AU, CA, DE, IT, UK, US, and Motors. If this information is provided on other marketplaces, it will be ignored.
This container is not always required, but is required if an inventory item is being updated and shipping package data already exists for that inventory item.

This container is returned in the getInventoryItem and getInventoryItems calls if package type, package weight, and/or package dimensions are specified for an inventory item.

See the Calculated shipping help page for more information on calculated shipping.

product.description:
This container is used to define the product details, such as product title, product description, product identifiers (eBay Product ID, GTIN, or Brand/MPN pair), product aspects/item specifics, and product images. Note that an eBay Product ID (ePID) or a Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) value can be used in an attempt to find a matching product in the eBay Catalog. If a product match is found, the inventory item record will automatically pick up all product details associated with the eBay Catalog product.

Many eBay categories will require at least one product identifier (a GTIN or a Brand/MPN pair). To discover which product identifier(s) that an eBay category might require or support, use the getItemAspectsForCategory method in the Taxonomy API. In the getItemAspectsForCategory response, look for product identifier names (brand, mpn, upc, ean, isbn) in the localizedAspectName fields, and then look for the corresponding aspectRequired boolean fields as well as the corresponding aspectUsage field, which will indicate if the aspect is required, recommended, or optional. In some cases, a product identifier type may be required, but not known/applicable for a product. If this is the case, the seller must still include the corresponding field in the inventory item record, but pass in a default text string. This text string can vary by site, so the seller should use the GeteBayDetails call of the Trading API to get this string value. In the GeteBayDetails call, the seller should include a DetailName field with its value set to ProductDetails. In the response of the call, the seller can see the default string value in the ProductDetails.ProductIdentifierUnavailableText field. The seller will use this value in one or more of the product identifier fields (ean, isbn, upc, or mpn) if a product ID isn't known or applicable.

variesBy.description:
This container is used to specify product aspects for which variations within an inventory item group vary, and a complete list of all those variances. For example, t-shirts in an inventory item group may be available in multiple sizes and colors. If this is the case, Color and Size would both be values in the specifications.name fields, and the available colors and sizes would be values under the corresponding specifications.values array. If the seller will be including multiple images in the listing that will demonstrate how each variation differs, that seller will also include the aspectsImageVariesBy field, and call out the product aspect where the listing images differ. In the t-shirts example, this product aspect would be Color, and the seller could either include URLs to images of the t-shirt (in available colors) through the inventory item group entity, or the seller could also included URLs to images of the t-shirt through the individual inventory item entities of the group.

This container is not initially required when first creating an inventory item group, but the variesBy.specifications container will be required before the first offer of the group is published.

This field is used to specify the phone number for an inventory location.

timeZoneId.description: The time zone of the inventory location in Olson format (for example America/Vancouver). Used for all hour-related fields; if omitted for a fulfillment center, it is derived from the address.

fulfillmentCenterSpecifications.description:
This container is used to specify information about a fulfillment center's shipping specifications, such as the weekly cut-off time schedule for order handling and any cut-off time overrides.

Note: This container is required if one of the locationTypes of the inventory location is FULFILLMENT_CENTER, and is not applicable to other location types.

InventoryLocationFull.description: Details of an inventory location for createInventoryLocation, including name, physical address, operating hours, special hours and phone number.

location.description: This container provides details of an inventory location. The address container will always be returned, but it will not always have a complete street address, as a WAREHOUSE location does not require a full street address. The geoCoordinates container will only be returned if the seller provided geographical coordinates. The locationId field is always returned, but this value is only used internally by eBay.

locationAdditionalInformation.description: This text field provides additional information about an inventory location. This field is returned if it is set for the location.

locationTypes.description: This array indicates if the inventory location is a warehouse or a fulfillment center.

locationWebUrl.description: This text field shows the  Website address (URL) associated with the inventory location. This field is returned if defined for the location.

merchantLocationKey.description: The unique identifier of the inventory location. This identifier is set up by the merchant when the location is first created with the createInventoryLocation call.

merchantLocationStatus.description: This field indicates whether the inventory location is enabled (inventory can be loaded to location) or disabled (inventory cannot be loaded to location). The merchant can use the enableInventoryLocation call to enable a location in disabled status, or the disableInventoryLocation call to disable a location in enabled status.

name.description: The name of the inventory location. This name should be a human-friendly name.

timeZoneId.description: The time zone of the inventory location in Olson format (for example America/Vancouver).

fulfillmentCenterSpecifications.description:
This container provides information about a fulfillment center's shipping specifications, such as the weekly cut-off time schedule for order handling and any cut-off time overrides.

Note: This field is only returned for fulfillment center locations.

InventoryLocationResponse.description: This type is used by the base response of the getInventoryLocation and getInventoryLocations calls. These responses provide details about inventory location(s) defined for the merchant's account.

LengthUnitOfMeasureEnum.description: Unit of measure for the dimensions of a shipping package.

listingId.description: The unique identifier of the eBay listing that is associated with the published offer.

listingOnHold.description: Whether the listing is on hold due to a policy violation. Returned as true while the listing is fixable and no longer returned once it is fixed.

listingStatus.description: The enumeration value returned in this field indicates the status of the listing that is associated with the published offer.

soldQuantity.description: This integer value indicates the quantity of the product that has been sold for the published offer.

ListingDetails.description: eBay listing ID, listing status and quantity sold for an offer. Returned only for published offers.

ListingDurationEnum.description: Listing duration periods. GTC applies to fixed-price listings and is their only supported duration; the DAYS_n values apply to auction listings.

bestOfferTerms.description:
This container is used if the seller would like to support the Best Offer feature on their listing. To enable the Best Offer feature, the seller will have to set the bestOfferEnabled field to true, and the seller also has the option of setting 'auto-accept' and 'auto-decline' price thresholds.

Note: Best Offer is unavailable for multi-variation listings.
This container is only returned if Best Offer is enabled on listing.

eBayPlusIfEligible.description: Set to true if a Top-Rated seller is opted in to the eBay Plus program (next-day delivery and free returns). Returned if set for the offer.

fulfillmentPolicyId.description: The ID of the fulfillment business policy that sets the fulfillment settings for the listing. Required before the offer can be published; returned if set.

paymentPolicyId.description: The ID of the payment business policy that sets the payment settings for the listing. Required before the offer can be published; returned if set.

productCompliancePolicyIds.description: The IDs of the seller's global product compliance policies to apply to the listing. Maximum of six per offer.

regionalProductCompliancePolicies.description:
A comma-delimited list of unique identifiers indicating the seller-created country-specific product compliance policies that that will be used once an offer is published and converted to a listing.

Product compliance policies provide buyers with important information and disclosures about products. For example, if you sell batteries in a country requiring disclosures that apply only to that country, a country-specific product compliance policy could contain this information.

Each offer may include up to six (6) product compliance policies for each of the following countries:
  • United Kingdom [GB]
  • Germany [DE]
  • France [FR]
  • Italy [IT]
  • Spain [ES]

For example, if a seller offers products in the UK, Germany, and Italy, each of which requires custom product compliance information, up to 18 policies (i.e., 6 policies x 3 countries,) may be included with each offer.Note: Product compliance policies that apply to all countries to which a seller ships are specified using productCompliancePolicyIds.

regionalTakeBackPolicies.description:
The list of unique identifiers indicating the seller-created country-specific take-back policies that will be used once an offer is published and converted to a listing. The law in some countries may require sellers to take back a used product when the buyer buys a new product.

Each offer may include one (1) country-specific take-back policy for each of the following countries:
  • United Kingdom [GB]
  • Germany [DE]
  • France [FR]
  • Italy [IT]
  • Spain [ES]

Note: Take-back policies that apply to all countries to which a seller ships are specified using takeBackPolicyId.

returnPolicyId.description: The ID of the return business policy that sets the return settings for the listing. Required before the offer can be published; returned if set.

shippingCostOverrides.description: Overrides the shipping costs or surcharge of shipping service options in the fulfillment policy, one entry per option. Returned if any overrides are applied.

takeBackPolicyId.description: The ID of the seller's global take-back policy to apply to the listing. Only one per offer.

ListingPolicies.description: Business policies (payment, return and fulfillment) and custom policies for the listing. Every published offer needs payment, return and fulfillment policies; also holds shipping cost overrides, eBay Plus and Best Offer settings.

ListingStatusEnum.description: Status of the eBay listing associated with an offer.

LocaleEnum.description: Locale that indicates the language used to express the inventory item details.

address.description: The address container is always returned in getInventoryLocation/getInventoryLocations calls. Except in the case of a fulfillment center location, a full address is not a requirement when setting up an inventory location.

geoCoordinates.description:
This container displays the Global Positioning System (GPS) latitude and longitude coordinates for the inventory location.

This container is only returned if the geo-coordinates are set for an inventory location.

locationId.description: The eBay-assigned ID of the location, used only internally by eBay. Not the same as the seller-defined merchantLocationKey.

Location.description: A complex type that is used to provide the physical address of a location, and it geo-coordinates.

merchantLocationKey.description: The seller-defined key of the fulfillment center location where inventory is available. For location mappings, it must be a FULFILLMENT_CENTER location.

LocationAvailabilityDetails.description: This type provides the unique identifier of an inventory location that is associated with a SKU within a listing.

address.description:
This required container sets the physical address of an inventory location. Except in the case of a fulfillment center location, a full address is not a requirement when setting up a location. For warehouse locations, the fields required in this container are either of the following sets:
  • city, stateOrProvince, and country
  • postalCode and country

geoCoordinates.description: This container is used to set the Global Positioning System (GPS) latitude and longitude coordinates for the inventory location. Geo-coordinates are used for FULFILLMENT_CENTER locations for delivery route-planning purposes (shorter distance to buyer generally means faster delivery). They are optional for WAREHOUSE locations.

LocationDetails.description: This type is used by the createInventoryLocation call to provide an full or partial address of an inventory location.

locations.description: The fulfillment center locations mapped to the SKU. Only the first 50 locations are used to calculate estimated delivery dates.

LocationMapping.description: This type provides an array of locations that are associated with a SKU within a listing.

href.description: The URI of the current page of results from the result set.

limit.description: The number of items returned on a single page from the result set.

next.description:
The URI for the following page of results. This value is returned only if there is an additional page of results to display from the result set.

Maximum length: 2048

offset.description: The number of results skipped before the first returned result, as set by the offset query parameter. The list is zero-based.

prev.description:
The URI for the preceding page of results. This value is returned only if there is a previous page of results to display from the result set.

Maximum length: 2048

total.description:
The total number of items retrieved in the result set.

If no items are found, this field is returned with a value of 0.

locations.description: An array of one or more of the merchant's inventory locations.

LocationResponse.description: This type is used by the base response payload for the getInventoryLocations call.

addressLine1.description:
The first line of the product manufacturer's street address.

Maximum length: 180 characters

addressLine2.description: The second line of the manufacturer's street address, such as a suite or apartment number. Maximum length: 180 characters.

city.description:
The city of the product manufacturer's street address.

Maximum length: 64 characters

companyName.description:
The company name of the product manufacturer.

Maximum length: 100 characters

contactUrl.description:
The contact URL of the product manufacturer.

Maximum length: 250 characters

country.description: This defines the list of valid country codes, adapted from ISO 3166-1 country codes. List elements take the form of a two-letter code (Alpha-2), a three-letter code (Alpha-3), and a three-digit code (Numeric). For example, the entry for Japan includes JP, JPN, 392. Short codes provide uniform recognition, avoiding language-dependent country names. The numeric code is helpful where Latin script may be problematic. Not all listed codes are universally recognized as countries. For example, Antarctica is AQ, ATA, 010.

email.description:
The product manufacturer's business email address.

Maximum length: 180 characters

phone.description:
The product manufacturer's business phone number.

Maximum length: 64 characters

postalCode.description:
The postal code of the product manufacturer's street address.

Maximum length: 9 characters

stateOrProvince.description:
The state or province of the product manufacturer's street address.

Maximum length: 64 characters

Manufacturer.description: This type provides name and contact information about the manufacturer of the item.

listingId.description: The unique identifier of the eBay listing to migrate to the Inventory model. Up to five listings can be specified.

MigrateListing.description: This type is used to specify one to five eBay listings that will be migrated to the new Inventory model.

errors.description: If one or more errors occur with the attempt to migrate the listing, this container will be returned with detailed information on each error.

inventoryItemGroupKey.description: The eBay-generated key of the inventory item group created for a migrated multiple-variation listing. Returned only for multiple-variation listings.

inventoryItems.description: The SKU values and offer IDs of the migrated listing: one pair for a single-variation listing, several for a multiple-variation listing.

listingId.description: The unique identifier of the eBay listing that the seller attempted to migrate.

marketplaceId.description: This is the unique identifier of the eBay Marketplace where the listing resides. The value fo the eBay US site will be EBAY_US.

statusCode.description: This field is returned for each listing that the seller attempted to migrate. See the HTTP status codes table to see which each status code indicates.

warnings.description: Details of any warnings raised while migrating the listing. A listing can still migrate successfully with warnings.

MigrateListingResponse.description: This type is used to display the results of each listing that the seller attempted to migrate.

MinimumAdvertisedPriceHandlingEnum.description: Controls how and when the Minimum Advertised Price is shown for an offer. Available only on the US site.

name.description: The motor vehicle aspect name, such as make, model, year, trim or engine. Make, model and year are typically required.

value.description: The value of the motor vehicle aspect named in the name field, for example Toyota for make.

NameValueList.description: This type is used by the compatibilityProperties container to identify a motor vehicle using name/value pairs.

offerId.description: The ID of an unpublished offer to retrieve expected listing fees for. Up to 250 per request; published offers cause errors.

OfferKeyWithId.description: Unpublished offer for which getListingFees retrieves expected listing fees. Up to 250 offerId values can be passed.

offers.description: The unpublished offers (up to 250) to retrieve expected listing fees for. Fees are returned per marketplace, not per offer.

OfferKeysWithId.description: This type is used by the base request payload of the getListingFees call.

availableQuantity.description: The quantity of the item available in the offer's marketplace; should not exceed the total ship-to-home quantity. Either this or price is required.

offerId.description: The unique identifier of the offer to update with a new price and/or quantity. Required when updating offers.

price.description: This container is used if the seller wants to modify the current price of the inventory item. The dollar value set here will be the new price of the inventory item in the offer (identified by the corresponding offerId value). Either the availableQuantity field or the price container is required, but not necessarily both.

OfferPriceQuantity.description: This type is used by the offers container in a Bulk Update Price and Quantity call to update the current price and/or quantity of one or more offers associated with a specific inventory item.

offerId.description: The unique identifier of the offer created by createOffer. Returned only on success and not returned by updateOffer.

warnings.description: This container will contain an array of errors and/or warnings when a call is made, and errors and/or warnings occur.

OfferResponse.description: Response of the createOffer and updateOffer calls with any errors or warnings. The offerId is returned only by a successful createOffer call.

errors.description: This container will be returned if there were one or more errors associated with publishing the offer.

listingId.description: The unique identifier of the newly-created eBay listing. This field is only returned if the seller successfully published the offer and created the new eBay listing.

offerId.description: The unique identifier of the offer that the seller published (or attempted to publish).

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code indicating whether publishing the offer succeeded or failed.

warnings.description: This container will be returned if there were one or more warnings associated with publishing the offer.

OfferResponseWithListingId.description: Publish status of an offer. Returns the eBay listing ID on success, or errors and/or warnings explaining why publishing failed.

errors.description: This container will be returned at the offer level, and will contain one or more errors if any occurred with the attempted creation of the corresponding offer.

format.description: This enumeration value indicates the listing format of the offer.

marketplaceId.description: This enumeration value is the unique identifier of the eBay marketplace for which the offer will be made available. This enumeration value should be the same for all offers since the bulkCreateOffer method can only be used to create offers for one eBay marketplace at a time.

offerId.description: The unique identifier of the newly created offer. Not returned if the offer could not be created.

sku.description: The seller-defined SKU of the inventory item. Required for each offer and always returned.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code of the offer creation attempt; 200 indicates success.

warnings.description: Warnings raised while creating the offer. An offer can still be created successfully with warnings.

OfferSkuResponse.description: Status of each offer the seller attempted to create with bulkCreateOffer. A successful offer has statusCode 200 and a new offerId; otherwise errors and/or warnings are returned.

OfferStatusEnum.description: Current status of the offer, published or unpublished.

href.description: This is the URL to the current page of offers.

limit.description: This integer value is the number of offers that will be displayed on each results page.

next.description: This is the URL to the next page of offers. This field will only be returned if there are additional offers to view.

offers.description: The seller's offers for the SKU passed in the sku query parameter. Maximum of 25.

prev.description: This is the URL to the previous page of offers. This field will only be returned if there are previous offers to view.

size.description: The number of offers on the current page of results.

total.description: The total number of offers for the SKU, used with the limit value to page through results.

Offers.description: This type is used by the base response of the getOffers call, and it is an array of one or more of the seller's offers, along with pagination data.

cutOffTime.description: The cut-off time that overrides the weekly schedule for the date range; orders after it are handled the next day. Format: 00:00.

endDate.description: The end date of the cut-off time override in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Use the same date as startDate for a single day.

startDate.description: The start date of the cut-off time override in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Use the same date as endDate for a single day.

Overrides.description: This type defines the override dates for cut-off times. This allows sellers to set special hours for their inventory location and specify different cut-off times on these days.

PackageTypeEnum.description: Type of shipping package used to ship an inventory item.

dimensions.description:
This container is used to indicate the length, width, and height of the shipping package that will be used to ship the inventory item. The dimensions of a shipping package are needed when calculated shipping is used.

This container will be returned if package dimensions are set for the inventory item.

packageType.description:
This enumeration value indicates the type of shipping package used to ship the inventory item. The supported values for this field can be found in the PackageTypeEnum type.

This field will be returned if the package type is set for the inventory item.

Note: You can use the GeteBayDetails Trading API call to retrieve a list of supported package types for a specific marketplace.

shippingIrregular.description: Whether the package is irregular and needs special or fragile handling. Applies to calculated shipping only.

weight.description:
This container is used to specify the weight of the shipping package that will be used to ship the inventory item. The weight of a shipping package are needed when calculated shipping is used, or if flat-rate shipping rates are used, but with a weight surcharge.

This field will be returned if package weight is set for the inventory item.

PackageWeightAndSize.description: Package type, weight and dimensions of the shipping package. Weight and dimensions are required for calculated shipping; weight alone is required for flat-rate shipping with a weight surcharge.

offers.description: The published offers whose price and/or quantity to update, one entry per offer. Not for unpublished offers.

shipToLocationAvailability.description: This container is needed if the seller is updating the total 'ship-to-home' quantity for the corresponding inventory item (specified in the sku field). A successful call will update the inventory item record associated with the sku value.

sku.description: The seller-defined SKU of the inventory item whose total ship-to-home quantity is updated. Required only when using shipToLocationAvailability. Maximum length: 50.

PriceQuantity.description: Updates the total ship-to-home quantity of inventory items and/or the price and quantity of specific offers associated with them.

errors.description: This array will be returned if there were one or more errors associated with the update to the offer or inventory item record.

offerId.description: The unique identifier of the offer that was updated. This field will not be returned in situations where the seller is only updating the total 'ship-to-home' quantity of an inventory item record.

sku.description: The seller-defined SKU of the product. Always returned. Maximum length: 50.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code of the price and/or quantity update attempt; 200 indicates success.

warnings.description: This array will be returned if there were one or more warnings associated with the update to the offer or inventory item record.

PriceQuantityResponse.description: Result for each offer or inventory item updated with bulkUpdatePriceQuantity, including any errors or warnings at that level.

auctionReservePrice.description:
This field indicates the lowest price at which the seller is willing to sell an item through an auction listing. Note that setting a Reserve Price will incur a listing fee of $5 or 7.5% of the Reserve Price, whichever is greater. The minimum fee is $5.

Important: This fee is charged regardless of whether or not the item is sold.

auctionStartPrice.description:
This field indicates the minimum bidding price for the auction. The bidding starts at this price.

Note: If the auctionReservePrice is also specified, the value of auctionStartPrice must be lower than the value of auctionReservePrice.

minimumAdvertisedPrice.description:
This container is needed if the Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) feature will be used in the offer. Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) is an agreement between suppliers (or manufacturers (OEM)) and the retailers (sellers) stipulating the lowest price an item is allowed to be advertised at. Sellers can only offer prices below this price through the use of other discounts. The MAP feature is only available to eligible US sellers. This field will be ignored if the seller and or the listing is not eligible for the MAP feature.

This container will be returned by getOffer and getOffers if set for the offer.

originallySoldForRetailPriceOn.description:
This field is needed if the Strikethrough Pricing (STP) feature will be used in the offer. This field indicates that the product was sold for the price in the originalRetailPrice field on an eBay site, or sold for that price by a third-party retailer. When using the createOffer or updateOffer calls, the seller will pass in a value of ON_EBAY to indicate that the product was sold for the originalRetailPrice on an eBay site, or the seller will pass in a value of OFF_EBAY to indicate that the product was sold for the originalRetailPrice through a third-party retailer. This field and the originalRetailPrice field are only applicable if the seller and listing are eligible to use the Strikethrough Pricing feature, a feature which is limited to the US (core site and Motors), UK, Germany, Canada (English and French versions), France, Italy, and Spain sites.

This field will be returned by getOffer and getOffers if set for the offer.

originalRetailPrice.description:
This container is needed if the Strikethrough Pricing (STP) feature will be used in the offer. The dollar value passed into this field indicates the original retail price set by the manufacturer (OEM). eBay does not maintain or validate the value supplied here by the seller. The dollar value in this field should always be more than the dollar value in the price container. This field and the originallySoldForRetailPriceOn field are only applicable if the seller and listing are eligible to use the Strikethrough Pricing feature, a feature which is limited to the US (core site and Motors), UK, Germany, Canada (English and French versions), France, Italy, and Spain sites. Compare the originalRetailPrice and the dollar value in the price field to determine the amount of savings to the buyer. This Original Retail Price will have a strikethrough line through for a marketing affect.

This container will be returned by getOffer and getOffers if set for the offer.

price.description:
This is the listing price of the product. A listing price must be specified before publishing an offer, but it is possible to create an offer without a price.

For published offers, this container will always be returned, but for unpublished offers, this container will only be returned if set for the offer.

Important!Publish offer note: This container and its two child fields (currency and value) are required before an offer can be published to create an active listing.

pricingVisibility.description:
This field is needed if the Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) feature will be used in the offer. This field is only applicable if an eligible US seller is using the Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) feature and a minimumAdvertisedPrice has been specified. The value set in this field will determine whether the MAP price is shown to a prospective buyer prior to checkout through a pop-up window accessed from the View Item page, or if the MAP price is not shown until the checkout flow after the buyer has already committed to buying the item. To show the MAP price prior to checkout, the seller will set this value to PRE_CHECKOUT. To show the MAP price after the buyer already commits to buy the item, the seller will set this value to DURING_CHECKOUT. This field will be ignored if the seller and/or the listing is not eligible for the MAP feature.

This field will be returned by getOffer and getOffers if set for the offer.

PricingSummary.description: Listing price and Minimum Advertised Price and Strikethrough Pricing settings. Price is required before an offer is published, but can be omitted when the offer is created.

aspects.description: Item specifics (product aspects) as name-value pairs describing the product. Required before an offer can be published. Maximum lengths: name 40, value 50.

brand.description: The brand of the product, often paired with mpn. Conditionally required if the category requires an MPN. Returned if defined. Maximum length: 65.

description.description: The description of the product; supports basic HTML but no active content. Required before an offer can be published. Returned if defined. Maximum length: 4000.

ean.description: The European Article Number (EAN) of the product, used to find a match in the eBay Catalog. Returned if defined.

epid.description: The eBay Product Identifier (ePID), the preferred way to match a product in the eBay Catalog and auto-populate product details. Returned if defined.

imageUrls.description: HTTPS URLs of the product images. At least one is required before an offer can be published; up to 24 per listing, or 12 per item in a group.

isbn.description: The International Standard Book Number (ISBN) of the product, used to find a match in the eBay Catalog. Returned if defined.

mpn.description: The Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) of the product, paired with brand. Required by some categories. Returned if defined. Maximum length: 65.

subtitle.description: An optional subtitle with extra product information; an additional listing fee applies. Returned only if set. Maximum length: 55.

title.description: The title of the inventory item. Required before an offer can be published; for a group, it becomes the variation title. Maximum length: 80.

upc.description: The Universal Product Code (UPC) of the product, used to find a match in the eBay Catalog. Returned if defined.

videoIds.description: The eBay-generated IDs of videos uploaded for the product. Only one video per listing is supported.

Product.description: Product details such as title, description, aspects and image links. Can include an ePID or GTIN (EAN, ISBN or UPC) to match a product in the eBay Catalog.

engine.description: Important! The productFamilyProperties container is no longer supported.

make.description: Important! The productFamilyProperties container is no longer supported.

model.description: Important! The productFamilyProperties container is no longer supported.

trim.description: Important! The productFamilyProperties container is no longer supported.

year.description: Important! The productFamilyProperties container is no longer supported.

ProductFamilyProperties.description: This type is used to specify the details of a motor vehicle that is compatible with the inventory item specified through the SKU value in the call URI.

epid.description: The eBay catalog product ID (ePID) of the compatible motor vehicle; if found, its properties are filled in automatically.

gtin.description: The Global Trade Item Number of the compatible motor vehicle. Reserved for future use.

ktype.description: The K Type Number of the compatible motor vehicle; if found, its properties are filled in automatically. Supported only on the AU, DE, ES, FR, IT and UK marketplaces.

ProductIdentifier.description: Identifies a motor vehicle compatible with the inventory item, by eBay Product ID or K-Type value. The gtin field is for future use only.

component.description: Product safety component information, such as a specific warning. Requires pictograms and/or statements. Maximum length: 120 characters.

pictograms.description: The identifiers of product safety pictograms to display on the listing. Maximum of 2.

statements.description: The identifiers of product safety statements to display on the listing. Maximum of 8.

ProductSafety.description: This type is used to define the pictograms and statement containers, and the optional component field, that provide product safety and compliance related information.

inventoryItemGroupKey.description: The eBay-generated key of the inventory item group whose unpublished offers are published as a multiple-variation listing.

marketplaceId.description: This is the unique identifier of the eBay site on which the multiple-variation listing will be published. The marketplaceId enumeration values are found in MarketplaceEnum.

PublishByInventoryItemGroupRequest.description: Request payload of publishByInventoryItemGroup, giving the inventory item group to publish and the eBay marketplace to publish it on.

listingId.description: The unique identifier of the newly created eBay listing. Returned if the offer or group of offers was successfully published.

warnings.description: This container will contain an array of errors and/or warnings if any occur when a publishOffer or publishOfferByInventoryItemGroup call is made.

PublishResponse.description: This type is used by the base response payload of the publishOffer and publishOfferByInventoryItemGroup calls.

countryPolicies.description: The array of country-specific product compliance policies to be used by an offer when it is published and converted to a listing.

RegionalProductCompliancePolicies.description: This type lists regional product compliance policies to be used by an offer when it is published and converted to a listing.

countryPolicies.description: The array of country-specific take-back policies to be used by an offer when it is published and converted to a listing.

RegionalTakeBackPolicies.description: This type lists regional take-back policies to be used by an offer when it is published and converted to a listing.

documents.description: Regulatory documents associated with the listing. Conditionally required for sellers in or shipping to the EU or Northern Ireland.

energyEfficiencyLabel.description:
This container provides information about the energy efficiency for certain durable goods.

Note: This container can be used to provide European energy efficiency (EEK) information for listings in the Tyres and Appliance categories for sellers in the EU and UK, and Smartphones and Tablets categories for sellers in the US, AU, CA, EU, and UK. If no EEK information is specified through this container, it may be retrieved through a third party vendor. For more information, see Energy efficiency information.
Note: Energy efficiency information is not required for all categories. Use the getRegulatoryPolicies method of the Metadata API to return metadata on the eBay categories that recommend or require energy efficiency-related fields.

Important! When providing energy efficiency information on an appliance or smartphones and tablets listing, the energy efficiency rating and range of the item must be specified through the aspects field when creating the inventory item record. Use the getItemAspectsForCategory method of the Taxonomy API to retrieve applicable rating and range values for a specified category.

hazmat.description:
This container is used by the seller to provide hazardous material information for the listing.

The statements element is required to complete the Hazmat section of a listing.

The following elements are optional:
  • pictograms
  • signalWord
  • component
Note: Hazmat information is not required for all categories. Use the getRegulatoryPolicies method of the Metadata API to return metadata on the eBay categories that recommend or require Hazmat-related fields.

manufacturer.description:
This container provides information about the manufacturer of the item.

Note: As a part of General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) requirements effective on December 13th, 2024, sellers operating in, or shipping to, EU-based countries or Northern Ireland are conditionally required to provide regulatory manufacturer information in their eBay listings. Manufacturer information is not required for all categories. Use the getRegulatoryPolicies method of the Metadata API to return metadata on the eBay categories that recommend or require manufacturer-related fields. For more information on GPSR, see General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR).

productSafety.description:
This container is used to provide product safety information for the listing. One of the following elements is required to complete the Product Safety section for a listing: pictograms or statements. The component element is optional.

Note: As a part of General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) requirements effective on December 13th, 2024, sellers operating in, or shipping to, EU-based countries or Northern Ireland are conditionally required to provide regulatory product safety information in their eBay listings. Product safety information is not required for all categories. Use the getRegulatoryPolicies method of the Metadata API to return metadata on the eBay categories that recommend or require product safety-related fields. For more information on GPSR, see General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR).

repairScore.description: The manufacturer's repair score, from 0.0 (difficult to repair) to 10.0 (easily repaired), with at most one decimal place. Not applicable to all categories.

responsiblePersons.description: The EU-based Responsible Persons or entities for the listing. Maximum of 5; conditionally required for sellers in or shipping to the EU or Northern Ireland.

Regulatory.description: Type defining regulatory information that the seller is required to disclose.

addressLine1.description:

addressLine2.description: The second line of the Responsible Person's address, such as a suite or apartment number. Maximum length: 180 characters.

city.description:
The city of the Responsible Person's street address.

Maximum length: 64 characters

companyName.description:
The name of the Responsible Person or entity.

Maximum length: 100 characters

contactUrl.description:
The contact URL of the Responsible Person or entity.

Maximum length: 250 characters

country.description: This defines the list of valid country codes, adapted from ISO 3166-1 country codes. List elements take the form of a two-letter code (Alpha-2), a three-letter code (Alpha-3), and a three-digit code (Numeric). For example, the entry for Japan includes JP, JPN, 392. Short codes provide uniform recognition, avoiding language-dependent country names. The numeric code is helpful where Latin script may be problematic. Not all listed codes are universally recognized as countries. For example, Antarctica is AQ, ATA, 010.

email.description:
The Responsible Person's email address.

Maximum length: 180 characters

phone.description:
The Responsible Person's business phone number.

Maximum length: 64 characters

postalCode.description:
The postal code of the Responsible Person's street address.

Maximum length: 9 characters

stateOrProvince.description:
The state of province of the Responsible Person's street address.

types.description:
The type(s) associated with the Responsible Person or entity.

Note: Currently, the only supported value is EUResponsiblePerson.

ResponsiblePerson.description: This type provides information, such as name and contact details, for an EU-based Responsible Person or entity, associated with the product.

ResponsiblePersonTypeEnum.description: Type of EU Responsible Person associated with a listing.

overrides.description: This container can be used to override the existing cut-off time(s), specified in the weeklySchedule container, for a specific date or date range.

weeklySchedule.description: The weekly schedule of shipping cut-off times, required for each business day; orders after the cut-off are handled the next day.

SameDayShippingCutOffTimes.description: This type is used by the createInventoryLocation call to specify cut-off time(s) for an inventory location, as well as any overrides for these times.

availabilityDistributions.description: The available quantity of the inventory item at one or more warehouse locations. Returned if set.

quantity.description: The total ship-to-home quantity available across all marketplaces. Must be set before an offer can be published; resend it on updates or it is lost.

ShipToLocationAvailability.description: This type is used to specify the total 'ship-to-home' quantity of the inventory item that will be available for purchase through one or more published offers.

allocationByFormat.description: This container is used to specify the quantity of the inventory item that is available for purchase, allocated by the offer types.

availabilityDistributions.description: The available quantity of the inventory item at one or more warehouse locations. Returned if set.

quantity.description: The total ship-to-home quantity available for purchase. Must be set before publishing; omitting it or 0 makes the listing out of stock. Resend it on updates or it is lost.

ShipToLocationAvailabilityWithAll.description: This type is used to specify the total 'ship-to-home' quantity of the inventory items that will be available for purchase through one or more published offers.

additionalShippingCost.description:
The dollar value passed into this field will override the additional shipping cost that is currently set for the applicable shipping service option. The "Additional shipping cost" is the cost to ship each additional identical product to the buyer using the corresponding shipping service. The shipping service option in the fulfillment policy to override is controlled by the shippingServiceType and priority values.

If using an updateOffer call, and this field is defined for the offer being updated, this field must be supplied again, even if its value is not changing.

This field is returned in the getOffer and getOffers calls if defined.

priority.description: The sort order of the shipping service option in the fulfillment policy whose costs are overridden. Required for each override and always returned.

shippingCost.description:
The dollar value passed into this field will override the shipping cost that is currently set for the applicable shipping service option. This value will be the cost to ship one item to the buyer using the corresponding shipping service. The shipping service option in the fulfillment policy to override is controlled by the shippingServiceType and priority values.

If using an updateOffer call, and this field is defined for the offer being updated, this field must be supplied again, even if its value is not changing.

This field is returned in the getOffer and getOffers calls if defined.

shippingServiceType.description:
This enumerated value indicates whether the shipping service specified in the priority field is a domestic or an international shipping service option. To override the shipping costs for a specific domestic shipping service in the fulfillment listing policy, this field should be set to DOMESTIC, and to override the shipping costs for each international shipping service, this field should be set to INTERNATIONAL. This value, along with priority value, sets which domestic or international shipping service option in the fulfillment policy that will be modified with updated shipping costs. Specifically, the shippingCostOverrides.shippingServiceType value in a createOffer or updateOffer call must match the shippingOptions.optionType value in a fulfillment listing policy, and the shippingCostOverrides.priority value in a createOffer or updateOffer call must match the shippingOptions.shippingServices.sortOrderId value in a fulfillment listing policy.

This field is always required when overriding the shipping costs of a shipping service option, and will be always be returned for each shipping service option whose costs are being overridden.

surcharge.description:
Note: DO NOT USE THIS FIELD. Shipping surcharges for shipping service options can no longer be set with fulfillment business policies. To set a shipping surcharge for a shipping service option, only the Shipping rate tables tool in My eBay can be used.
The dollar value passed into this field will override the shipping surcharge that is currently set for the applicable shipping service option. The shipping service option in the fulfillment policy to override is controlled by the shippingServiceType and priority values.

If using an updateOffer call, and this field is defined for the offer being updated, this field must be supplied again, even if its value is not changing.

This field is returned in the getOffer and getOffers calls if defined.

ShippingCostOverride.description: Overrides the shipping cost for one item, each additional item, or the surcharge of a domestic or international shipping service option in the fulfillment policy applied to the offer.

ShippingServiceTypeEnum.description: Whether the shipping service option whose costs are overridden is domestic or international.

SoldOnEnum.description: Where the product was sold for the originalRetailPrice: on eBay, off eBay, or both. Applies only to listings eligible for Strikethrough Pricing.

name.description: The name of the product variation aspect, such as Size or Color. Required before an offer can be published. Maximum length: 40.

values.description: The values of the product variation aspect named in the name field. At least one value is required. Maximum length: 50.

Specification.description: Product aspect on which variations within an inventory item group vary, such as size or color, and the order its values appear in the listing.

StatusEnum.description: Possible states of an inventory location.

StoreTypeEnum.description: Inventory location types. STORE is deprecated and no longer supported.

applyTax.description: Whether the seller's account-level sales-tax table is used to calculate sales tax. Must be true when thirdPartyTaxCategory is used. Returned if set.

thirdPartyTaxCategory.description: The tax exception category code, which applies sales tax to a service or fee as well as the item price. Requires applyTax set to true. Returned if set.

vatPercentage.description: The VAT rate for the item, up to 6 characters with 3 decimal places (for example 12.345). Only for business sellers with a registered VAT-ID. Returned if set.

Tax.description: Enables a sales-tax table, sets a tax exception category code, or specifies a VAT percentage. Sales-tax tables are available only for the US and Canada marketplaces.

unit.description: This enumeration value indicates the time unit used to specify the fulfillment time, such as BUSINESS_DAY.

value.description: The fulfillment time, in the unit given by the unit field.

TimeDuration.description: This type is used to indicate the fulfillment time for an order that will be shipped to the buyer.

TimeDurationUnitEnum.description: Time unit used by the TimeDuration type, typically BUSINESS_DAY for order fulfillment time.

aspectsImageVariesBy.description: The product aspect, such as Color, whose variations are shown with different images. Only the first aspect is used. Required before an offer can be published.

specifications.description: The product aspects that vary across the group and their values. Required before the first offer of the group is published; returned if set or once published.

VariesBy.description: This type is used to specify the product aspect(s) where individual items of the group vary, as well as a list of the available variations of those aspects.

version.description: The version number of the service or API.

Version.description: This type is used to show the version number and instance of the service or API.

cutOffTime.description: The cut-off time in 24-hour format for the specified days; defaults to the address time zone if timeZoneId is not set. Days without one are holidays. Format: 00:00.

dayOfWeekEnum.description: This comma-separated array defines the days of week for which the specified cutOffTime is used.

WeeklySchedule.description: This type describes the weekly schedule for cut-off times.

unit.description: The unit of measurement used to specify the weight of a shipping package. Both the unit and value fields are required if the weight container is used. If the English system of measurement is being used, the applicable values for weight units are POUND and OUNCE. If the metric system of measurement is being used, the applicable values for weight units are KILOGRAM and GRAM. The metric system is used by most countries outside of the US.

value.description: The weight of the shipping package in the unit given by the unit field. Both unit and value are required.

Weight.description: Weight of a shipping package and its unit of measure. Conditionally required for calculated shipping rates or flat-rate shipping with a weight surcharge.

WeightUnitOfMeasureEnum.description: Unit of measure for the weight of a shipping package.

inventoryItemGroupKey.description: The eBay-generated unique identifier of the inventory item group.

marketplaceId.description: This is the unique identifier of the eBay site for which the offer will be made available. See MarketplaceEnum for supported values.

WithdrawByInventoryItemGroupRequest.description: This type is used by the base request of the WithdrawByInventoryItemGroup method, which is used to end a multiple-variation listing.

listingId.description: The unique identifier of the eBay listing associated with the offer that was withdrawn. This field will not be returned if the eBay listing was not successfully ended.

warnings.description: This container will be returned if there were one or more warnings associated with the attempt to withdraw the offer.

WithdrawResponse.description: The base response of the withdrawOffer call.
